name: Customizable rubber band loom fishtail maker

captions.detailed: This 3D model features a circular loom design, consisting of a flat triangular ring base with a large central triangular hole. Positioned at regular intervals around the perimeter are several vertical pins, which are hollowed out and feature rectangular notches on their outer faces. The pins are tall and slender, matching the low-polygon styling of the triangular base.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric circular loom for rubber band crafting. It should feature an adjustable base ring (with customizable outer size, inner hole size, and height) and a configurable number of vertical pins arranged radially, where each pin has adjustable height, wall thickness, and notch settings to hold bands securely.
captions.factory: The script constructs a base ring using a difference of two low-polygon cylinders to create a triangular ring. The vertical pins are generated in a loop, rotating each pin module around the center. Each pin is created from a scaled cylinder that is hollowed out with a smaller cylinder, notched using a translated cube, and then cleaned up using a difference operation with an outer ring to shear off excess pin geometry.
